_readme: ROI pixel coordinates in the ALIGNED full RGB image.
Full images are RGB (1504x8000 BMP). ROI crops are saved as grayscale.
These coords MUST match how the 3 pre-cropped grayscale folders were extracted on the remote PC.
Person C: open golden_master image in GIMP or Paint.net, note pixel coords of each region.
Fields: x=left edge, y=top edge, w=width, h=height. All values in pixels.
critical=true = stricter threshold (lower tolerance for missed defects).
IMPORTANT: Replace placeholder values below with real measurements.

ROI_LOGO._note: FILL IN: Himalaya logo + Since 1930 + product name. Approx top-third of 8000px tall strip.

ROI_INGREDIENT._note: FILL IN: Ingredient bar + graphics + claims area. Middle section.

ROI_BARCODE._note: FILL IN: Barcode + batch code / MFG / EXP date. Bottom section.
